new_findings_today.title: NakshIQ's 'The Window' newsletter sent its first-ever real issue through the new per-recipient delivery pipeline -- 9/9 accepted by Resend, 8/9 confirmed delivered, 1/9 has zero delivery signal of any kind
new_findings_today.detail: newsletter_sends went from 0 (08-28) to 9; newsletter_events went from 1 to 14. The long-running 'The Window' weekly editorial page (20 published issues since 2026-04-19, unrelated to today's finding) had its content actually emailed out for the first time via the per-recipient observability pipeline shipped 2026-08-27: issue Nº 019 ('Kaza scores 10.0/10 this week', issue_slug 2026-08-w5) went to all 9 rows in newsletter_subscribers at 2026-08-30 01:30:11 UTC, each with a unique resend_email_id (i.e. Resend accepted and queued all 9). 8 of the 9 recipients have a confirmed email.delivered webhook event, all landing within about 1 second of each other. The 9th, ashish@forgevoice.studio, has NO webhook event at all -- not delivered, not bounced, not complained, nothing -- despite having a valid resend_email_id. This is presented as an open question, not a confirmed failure: it may simply not have arrived at Resend's webhook relay yet, or that specific mailbox may silently drop/filter without generating a bounce event Resend can see. Separately, this snapshot also reconfirms the already-tracked cross-product Resend-account sharing (NEW-2026-08-25-002): 3 more 'Manifestation OS' daily sends and 2 'Chanakya Ops' pipeline-alert emails also landed in newsletter_events this window, none related to NakshIQ's own newsletter content.

new_findings_today.recommendation: No action required on the send itself -- this looks like a successful pipeline launch. Worth a quick founder check on why ashish@forgevoice.studio shows zero webhook signal (could be as simple as checking that inbox, or checking Resend's own dashboard for that specific email_id). Also a good moment to revisit the standing NEW-2026-08-25-002 question now that a 3rd sender pattern (NakshIQ Success OS) has appeared alongside Manifestation OS and Chanakya Ops -- all sharing the same newsletter@/ops@nakshiq.com Resend account/webhook.
